name: Nondual-Bot-Benchmark
description:
Nondual Bot Benchmark v1.0
	

50 questions that separate genuine contemplative understanding from parroting, new-age contamination, and spiritual bypassing.
This benchmark was designed for one purpose: to stress-test AI models claiming to engage with nondual or contemplative teaching. It is harder than it looks.

	
		
		The Problem This Solves
	

Every major LLM has been trained on spiritual text. Every major LLM will confidently produce spiritual-sounding output. Most of it is… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Sathman/Nondual-Bot-Benchmark.
reputation: Niche benchmark used to probe models' understanding of nondual contemplative material; limited adoption outside safety/alignment and niche research communities.
